announcements.title: StegZ 1.4 for Windows
announcements.message:
• Credits to Havenova X in Settings (click to visit)
• "Don't show this again" on announcements
• Text editor, archive previews and instant archive opening
Tip: press F1 for the Help guide.

announcements.title: StegZ 2.2 for Android
announcements.message:
• Rebuilt natively: files open instantly, with search and largest-files finder
• Hide files in pictures or .stegz files, with a password tick-box and self-destruct
• Open text/code (with colours), images, PDF, audio and video inside the app
• ZIP, 7z, TAR, GZ, BZ2 and XZ: any size, live progress and notifications
• New: optional "Support us" screen
Made by Havenova X - havenovax.name.ng
